message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "The containment check in `extractFile` is inadequate: it uses `f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith(dir.getAbsolutePath())` without normalizing/canonicalizing the path and without a trailing separator, so a crafted archive entry name such as one containing `../` can still resolve outside the destination directory while passing the prefix check. Attacker-controlled data from `ZipEntry.getName()` flows through `entryName` into `FileUtils.resolveFile` and then to the `new FileOutputStream(f)` sink."}]}
